question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym of the given word.**

Idol
solution: The correct answer is **"Idle."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"idol"** has several homonyms, which means words that sound alike but have different meanings. • **Idol (noun)** means a representation or symbol of a god or goddess (किसी देवता या देवी का प्रतिनिधित्व या प्रतीक), while **Idle (adjective)** means not working or active (काम नहीं कर रहा या सक्रिय नहीं) • **​Example: ***There were many **idols**__ in my room.* • **Example**: *After finishing her work, she had some __**idle**__ time to relax.* • The correct answer is** Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (eye lid)** refers to the movable part that covers and uncovers the eye. (वह गतिशील भाग जो आँख को ढकता और उजागर करता है) • **Option 2 (doll)** refers to a child's toy that resembles a human being or an animal. (बच्चों का खिलौना जो मनुष्य या जानवर जैसा दिखता हो) • **Option 4 (dull) **means lacking interest or excitement, or not sharp or intense. (रुचि या उत्साह की कमी, या तीव्र या तीव्र नहीं) 1b4:T655, The correct answer is **"Having a complaint that needs to be discussed."**
